long_description:
Houston, get ready for some TAMASHA🔥

BrownTown presents TAMASHA, taking over STATUS Houston for a full Bollywood nightlife experience packed with Desi anthems, Punjabi hits, throwbacks, club remixes, immersive visuals, and nonstop energy from start to finish. The night kicks off with DJ Rosh setting the vibe and getting the crowd moving. Then DJ EXO, flying in from Toronto, takes over and keeps the energy going all the way through close. Expect a packed dance floor, big drops, flashing lights, high-energy sets, and the kind of crowd that does not stop moving. This is not your regular Bollywood night. This is TAMASHA. Loud, electric, chaotic in the best way, and built for a night you will actually remember.

🔥 TAMASHA 🗓️ Saturday, October 24 📍 STATUS | 5002 Washington Ave ⏰ 10 PM to 2 AM 🎧 DJ Rosh | DJ EXO 🔞 18+ 🥂 VIP Sections: 832-677-3213

Grab your tickets, bring your crew, dress to impress, get the group chat moving, and come ready to make some noise.

Valid government-issued ID required for entry. By attending, you consent to photography and videography for BrownTown marketing.
